Here's a self-contained prompt to hand to an implementation agent. It's scoped to **kick off Phase 1 of #2864 with the money-critical journal/reducer/trail spine first**, codex-design-first as the doctrine requires for money-handling code:
 [...] > **Scope this task to the money-critical spine only** (later Phase-1 items — backend selection policy, the `PaymentPort` adapter move, the full action namespace, the `"wallet"` projection — are follow-on PRs under #2864, do not build them here):
> 1. Scaffold the new Layer-4 crate `crates/nmp-wallet` (parked/excluded from the default workspace, same posture `nmp-nip60` had, since its actions aren't shippable yet — confirm the parking approach against the epic).
> 2. Define the `WalletBackend` seam per the design: actor-owned, command-shaped, returns `Vec<ActorCommand>`, never blocks across FFI, capability-flag model (absent capability ≠ runtime failure). [...] > **Process (mandatory):** this is money-handling code — get a **codex problem/solution design first** (crate module layout + the journal/saga/trail split) before implementing. Work in an **isolated worktree**, branch + **PR** (never push master). Scope tests to `cargo test -p nmp-wallet -p nmp-nip60` plus `cargo test -p nmp-testing --test doctrine_lint_smoke`; do **not** run `cargo test --workspace`. Run **codex review on your diff before opening the PR**; promote any actionable findings to a GitHub issue and discard the review artifact (never commit it). Open a ready-for-review PR (TLDR + detailed overview + tradeoffs), reference #2864, clean up the worktree when done. [...] Two notes on the prompt: I deliberately **narrowed "all this work" to the spine** — Phase 1 in one PR would be a huge, hard-to-review money-handling change, and the epic already lists the other Phase-1 items as separate checkboxes. If you'd rather one agent own the *entire* Phase 1 vertically, say so and I'll broaden it — but I'd recommend the spine-first slice. Also, want me to actually dispatch this agent now (background, isolated worktree), or are you handing the prompt off yourself? [...] Assistant: Yes — the ground moved. **PR #2871 "WIP: introduce nmp-wallet composition owner" is already open**, so Phase 1 scaffolding is in flight. Let me see how far it's gotten before I revise the prompt.

Assistant: PR #2871 already scaffolds the crate — including a `journal.rs`. Let me check whether its journal reflects the #2869 design (three-concern split + event-sourced trail) or the older linear saga, and whether it carries the compat-alias problem.

Assistant: Confirmed — the grep's `17` was mostly false hits on "St**ring**". The reality: **PR #2871's `journal.rs` is the *old* linear saga only** (`WalletOperationState { Draft, Prepared, MintPending, MintSettled, PublishPending, Settled, Unknown, Failed }` + `WalletOperationJournal`). There is **no `WalletFact` reducer, no causal trail ring, no per-atom cause index, no `StateRebuilt`, no confluence** — i.e. none of the #2869 design that answers "why is the state this shape." [...] **1. "Scaffold the crate" is already done.** PR #2871 (draft, branch `codex/2864-wallet-phase1-slice`) created `crates/nmp-wallet` with `backend.rs`, `capability.rs`, `journal.rs`, `payment_port.rs`, `projection.rs`, ownership + release-manifest wiring. The task is now **extend that branch**, not start from zero.

**2. The journal spine is still unbuilt — and #2869 hasn't landed.** #2871's journal is pre-#2869. And my design note **PR #2869 is still OPEN with failing CI** (`UNSTABLE`), so the design of record isn't merged yet. That has to land (and its CI fixed) before the journal work, or the implementer builds against an unmerged spec.

**3. #2871 already carries the compat-alias violation.** Its own tradeoffs say `nmp.wallet.connect/disconnect/pay_invoice` "remain compatibility aliases" — that's exactly finding **G** from the #2854 review, and it violates the owner's zero-tolerance no-compat-aliases rule. It needs a hard-break, not carry-forward.
 [...] > 3. **Remove the compat aliases** (`nmp.wallet.connect/disconnect/pay_invoice`): hard-break to the canonical backend-specific namespace and update all callers in the same PR — no aliases (owner zero-tolerance rule; finding G from the #2854 review).
>
> **Process:** money-handling code → get a **codex problem/solution design first** for the journal/saga/trail split before implementing. Scope tests to `cargo test -p nmp-wallet -p nmp-nip60` + `cargo test -p nmp-testing --test doctrine_lint_smoke`; never `--workspace`. **codex review before PR**; promote findings to issues, discard the artifact. Keep it on the existing PR #2871 (move it out of draft when ready) rather than opening a competing PR; clean up the worktree when done.
